field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF and final rows were independently checked. All 31 non-slash Dap/YZ462 MIC cells in Table 1 match final table activity rows, but accepted record PMC12606902-ACT-INVIVO-MOUSE-SURVIVAL-01 binds raw_value 90% to dose_value '10; 20'. Source text binds 90% survival only to 20 mg/kg; 10 mg/kg is described as inferior, so the accepted field is conflated.

Authoritative database linkage was checked and has zero linked article, assay, sequence, or literature rows. The two daptomycin fallback machine rows remain unresolved candidate evidence, source_verified_count is 0, and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false. This preserves the boundary but is not authoritative database-release evidence.

All six current final JSON files are byte-identical between paper final and packet final mirrors; mechanism_evidence.json and mechanism_ontology_record.json are byte-identical aliases. Final counts match review_report: 33 activity records, 9 toxicity records, 1 database audit, 7 mechanism claims. Live packet rework state has zero open tickets; no final review_report open_rework_ticket_count field is present to conflict with it.

Seven mechanism claims were reviewed against XML/PDF/supplement locators: 3 direct_mechanism claims have direct assay types, 3 phenotype_supported claims are not promoted to direct mechanism, and the daptomycin fallback/comparator scope remains unknown_or_not_tested. ROS and biofilm evidence remain phenotype-level.

PMCID, PMID, DOI, title, journal, and year match the primary XML/PDF. Entity boundaries are preserved: YZ462 is the paper's small-molecule antimicrobial agent, while daptomycin is only a comparator/fallback database candidate. Because authoritative linked database rows are absent, this paper is not authoritative AMP ingest-ready.

The required source, packet extracted/database/locators/analysis/rework, work, final, run log, and strict audit paths are readable. Locator artifacts validate table coordinates and source surfaces, but accepted source_verified/direct fields are not fully locator-faithful: the mouse survival 90% value is bound to an extra 10 mg/kg dose, and hemolytic IC50 omits the source-reported rabbit target species.

Current final objects contain no plain one-letter sequence plus sequence_length pair requiring residue-count reconciliation. Fallback rows are not source_verified and are not authoritative DBAASP/RC2/portal ingest-ready; authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false in both database final and review report.

The current strict acceptance artifact reports zero hard findings and all prior packet rework tickets are closed, but the preserved scientific caution remains: daptomycin fallback rows lack authoritative linked rows and source-located sequence/modification identity. No APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP cross-database conflict is smoothed into source_verified.

Both staged supplements were inspected. MOESM1 is ASCII/tabular text with 458 rows in the recovered table surface; MOESM2 is a legacy DOC recovered through antiword/docbook plus OLE/CDX text handling. The packet reports two supplementary files, 11 supplementary tables, 28 supplementary text records, no open material gaps, and no unparsed embedded object count.

The final covers the p33 cytotoxicity, hemolysis, acute mouse toxicity, Fig. S2 body-weight, Galleria LD50, and Fig. S7 qualitative eukaryotic membrane-permeability surfaces. However, record PMC12606902-TOX-HEM-IC50-01 sets target_species to 'not explicitly reported by source locator' even though xml:p:33/PDF page 7 explicitly report rabbit erythrocytes for the 6368.1 µM hemolytic IC50.

blocking_findings.reason: Current final/activity_toxicity_evidence.json still contains material worker-2 field errors. In $.activity_records[32] / record_id PMC12606902-ACT-INVIVO-MOUSE-SURVIVAL-01, raw_value=90 and normalized_unit=% are marked direct while assay_conditions.dose_value is '10; 20'; xml:p:59 and PDF page 13 bind 90% survival only to 20 mg/kg, while 10 mg/kg is only described as inferior. In $.toxicity_records[3] / record_id PMC12606902-TOX-HEM-IC50-01, the 6368.1 µM hemolytic IC50 is source-located to xml:p:33/PDF page 7, but target_species is 'not explicitly reported by source locator' even though the source says rabbit erythrocytes. These are source-reviewable, material field-level conflations/omissions, so the green strict gate cannot support publication-grade PASS.

Update the hemolytic IC50 toxicity record so the target species/context preserves rabbit erythrocytes from xml:p:33/PDF page 7.
Keep all final paper and packet mirrors byte-identical after repair and keep fallback database rows excluded from authoritative ingest.
Run or add field-level checks that bind outcome values to dose tokens and toxicity targets to source text, then rerun the semantic and publication gates without allow-risk/allow-findings.
